_comment: Copy this file to your kumi state directory as overrides.json (by default .kumi/overrides.json in the project, or $KUMI_STATE_DIR/overrides.json if you set that). Rules under 'all' apply to every specialist. Rules under a specialist's name (jaan, mart, and so on) apply only to that one. Each rule is an object with a 'rule' field, so adding one is copying a line and changing the text. kumi reads this at the start of a session and applies your rules on top of the built-in ones without changing any source file.

jaan.rule: Use the project's error-wrapping helper, not fmt.Errorf.

mart.rule: Flag any exported symbol missing a doc comment.
